claims.sentence: The primary objective of this trial is to investigate if a daily dose of minimum 50 billion CFU of Bif195 reduces the risk of small-intestinal tissue damage in an acetylsalicylic acid challenge model as assessed by video capsule endoscopy in a healthy US population aged 40 - 60 years.
claims.context_window: ideo capsule endoscopy in a healthy US population aged 40 - 60 years.
